status: Five accepted visual references; Wardsteel cuirass remains pending
reference_usage_guidance: Initial references for further invention, never a fixed cast, wardrobe, faction uniform or exhaustive list of magic. Visual approval alone does not settle mechanics, prevalence, taxonomy or faction ownership.

images.title: Ashwing keeper
images.intent: Quiet necromancy through an animated bird familiar, with the means of animation left unseen.
images.boundary: A small made companion tests necromancy without deciding how souls, costs or faction ownership work.
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original Breachline fantasy concept study, landscape 1536x1024. Traditional painted realism in oil and gouache: confident economical brushwork, selective sharp detail, soft lost edges, matte natural materials, convincing anatomy. High fantasy with medieval craftsmanship. Pale warm neutral paper background, a little contact shadow, generous breathing room; no scenic setting, no typography, no frames, no watermark. Main complete subject occupies left two thirds, two generously sized matching detail studies on the right. All designs are exploratory references; keep the idea clear and magical effects restrained. Magic should have a subject-specific appearance, never default to luminous threads, ribbons, cables, particle swarms or floating holographic symbols. No gold summoner mark. A full-length middle-aged human male keeper of an animated skeletal raven, age about 43, lean angular appealing but individual face, slightly crooked nose, short ash-blond graying hair, small upper-lip scar, measured thoughtful expression. Simple charcoal wool overcoat with faded plum lining, modest linen collar, dark trousers and worn calf boots, one small practical belt pouch. Few sensible layers, no skull jewelry, no elaborate gothic villain costume. He stands naturally in three-quarter view, looking toward the small raven resting on his gloved raised hand at chest height, other arm relaxed. The raven is unmistakably an animated dead bird, an elegant coherent framework of old ivory avian bones with a few remaining black feathers at the wings and tail; its skull turns alertly and one wing lifts slightly. Dry clean bones, no blood or flesh. Its life is expressed by attentive behavior and suspended wing articulation; no visible controlling tether, no glowing eye beams or machinery. Two right-hand details: the keeper's distinctive face, and an anatomically legible close-up of the skeletal raven on the glove. Muted plum, charcoal, warm bone and pale paper palette; slightly uncanny but intimate and calm.
images.visual_review: Full figure and matching portrait/bird details. The skeletal familiar communicates animation without a visible energy feed.

images.title: Storm-touched bull
images.intent: A creature carries a modest storm charge as part of its presence and behavior.
images.boundary: Tests creature-borne weather magic; scale, range and any relationship to the Elder Herd remain open.

Magic should have a subject-specific appearance, never default to luminous threads, ribbons, cables, particle swarms or floating holographic symbols. No gold summoner mark. A complete great bull in calm three-quarter profile, approximately 2.3 meters at the shoulder, heavy believable aurochs anatomy: powerful shoulders, thick neck, cloven hooves, shaggy charcoal and brown hide, broad sweeping natural horns, robust living face and dark expressive eyes. This is a living high-fantasy animal, not a metal construct. Quiet storm magic belongs to the creature: a few hairs along the mane stand with static, and only TWO OR THREE tiny jagged white-violet sparks jump briefly between neighboring horn ridges or nearby raised hairs. Electric marks must be short crisp branching cracks, not long arcs connecting horns or ribbons around the body. Keep the animal's bulk and natural coat overwhelmingly dominant. No encasing lightning aura, no storm cloud, no harness, saddle, goggles, vegetation costume or technological additions. Feet firmly on the simple ground shadow. Right upper detail shows natural horn texture with one small static snap and raised mane; right lower detail shows the heavy alert face and moist natural muzzle. Warm dark natural fur against pale paper, tiny cool electrical accents. An exceptional wild creature with weight and quiet power, no heroic action pose.
images.visual_review: Complete natural bull anatomy with small isolated static sparks and matching horn/face details.
images.creator_feedback: i like the bull in number 2 as well, would need additional elements in the scene to bring energy to it
images.approval_scope: Bull design accepted as a reference; a finished scene needs additional elements to bring energy.
images.scene_guidance: Develop energy through purposeful scene staging and supporting elements. Action, weather, terrain or interactions are possible choices, not requirements or newly established powers. The neutral reference pose is not the default for finished art.

images.title: Wardsteel cuirass
images.intent: An enchantment belongs to well-made armor, adding a useful property without extra apparatus.
images.boundary: Tests a localized protective enchantment; it does not establish invulnerability or a faction-wide kit.

Magic should have a subject-specific appearance, never default to luminous threads, ribbons, cables, particle swarms or floating holographic symbols. No gold summoner mark. An adult female ORC warrior in practical high-medieval armor, standing unthreatened in a relaxed full-body three-quarter reference pose. She is genuinely nonhuman: massive projecting square jaw, broad flat nose, heavy brow ridge, coarse olive-brown skin, two irregular short tusks, broad strong neck and large muscular frame. Her gender is expressed subtly through build, NOT a pretty human face painted green. Mature, self-possessed, cropped dark hair with one small braid. One beautifully made plain dark heat-blued steel cuirass with subtle hammered finish and a functional articulated lower edge over an ochre linen shirt, simple slate trousers and sturdy boots. No molded breast cups, exposed cleavage, excessive leather flaps, decorative straps, gauntlet devices or matching faction uniform. She looks down while checking one plain cuirass fastening with a hand, other arm relaxed. The armor is enchanted within its material. Main figure's plate looks like ordinary quality steel with a faint pearly sheen on one shallow dent, no glowing runes or shields. Right upper detail: this SAME cuirass alone, empty, hung simply to show its whole shape. Right lower detail is a close study of a TEST on an unoccupied matching armor plate: a single buckled arrowhead pressed against a tiny point of white reflected light on the metal, shaft fractured at the head, showing a localized protective response. It must clearly be an isolated material test with no person being hit. No translucent forcefield, no arrows flying at the character, no laser effect. Restrained steel, ochre and slate palette.
images.visual_review: Complete orc wearer, separate cuirass and isolated arrow-impact material test. Simple construction and localized metal sheen.

images.title: Rite of stillness
images.intent: A shared sacred rite offers a quiet response to the restless dead.
images.boundary: Tests communal magic around death without depicting a proven afterlife or a god answering.

Traditional painted realism in oil and gouache: confident economical brushwork, selective sharp detail, soft lost edges, matte natural materials, convincing anatomy. High fantasy with medieval craftsmanship. Pale warm neutral paper background, a little contact shadow, generous breathing room; no scenic setting, no typography, no frames, no watermark. Main complete subject occupies left two thirds, two generously sized matching detail studies on the right. All designs are exploratory references; keep the idea clear and magical effects restrained. Magic should have a subject-specific appearance, never default to luminous threads, ribbons, cables, particle swarms or floating holographic symbols. No gold summoner mark. A solemn quiet communal rite performed by TWO ordinary adult human keepers beside a completely shrouded deceased adult on a low plain wooden bier. No exposed face, injuries or gore. Main group fully visible left: an older woman with a lined broad face, gray hair tied back, plain muted ivory wool shawl and dull blue dress, one hand resting lightly on the linen shroud; a middle-aged male helper in a simple russet wool tunic and trousers stands on the other side with an open relaxed hand. Both are individual believable ordinary people, focused and compassionate. A single small earthenware lamp on the floor provides a point of warmth. Magic is almost still: the cloth near the woman's hand has a soft interior warmth, with a few faint dark ash-like flecks settling toward the floor instead of rising; a narrow patch of disturbed shadow beneath the bier is becoming calm. Let quiet light, posture and settling dust carry the idea. No visible ghost, soul figure, celestial vision, halo, shining threads, beams or magical scroll machinery. Minimal pale neutral background and a modest patch of floor only, no graveyard scene. Two right-hand details: the older keeper's expressive gentle face and hand on plain linen, and the small lamp beside settling dark dust. The effect should feel sacred and consequential but restrained, no spectacle.
images.visual_review: Two keepers, fully shrouded bier, matching hand and lamp details. Quiet warmth and settling dark flecks carry the proposed rite.

images.title: Quarry singer
images.intent: A goblin specialist uses voice and resonance to help ordinary quarry workers split stone.
images.boundary: Tests magic with a clear practical value at a worksite; it leaves labor, prevalence and costs unresolved.

Magic should have a subject-specific appearance, never default to luminous threads, ribbons, cables, particle swarms or floating holographic symbols. No gold summoner mark. A worksite study centered on a mature adult female GOBLIN quarry specialist using her voice to help split a heavy stone block. Goblins are small wiry adult people about 1.1 meters tall with large expressive ears, long broad noses, strong brow shapes and olive-brown skin; not children, elves, human models or cartoon gremlins. The central goblin has an individual mature face, tied-back dark hair, rolled plain linen sleeves, simple canvas work apron, wool trousers and worn boots. She stands beside a 3-meter-long knee-to-chest-high rough limestone workpiece, one bare palm near its surface, mouth slightly open in focused sustained singing, not screaming. TWO other adult goblin workers in differently colored simple practical work clothes use ordinary iron wedges and a pry bar along a controlled natural fracture; their action is complementary, anatomically coherent, no crowded limbs. The magic is shown through very fine dust shivering above the block, a few tiny grit grains trembling and a clean newly opened fracture. No glowing cracks, visible musical notes, sound rings, beams, threads, floating rocks, rune program, casting gadget or hologram. The work remains physical and plausible; the singer helps a heavy block separate cleanly, rather than dissolving mountains. Include complete main group and workpiece left, only modest floor and tools, pale empty background. Right upper detail: the adult singer's concentrated face and open hand beside stone; lower detail: ordinary wedge and a crisp stone fracture with fine dust. Work clothes and warm limestone, quiet afternoon-like studio light.
images.visual_review: Three adult goblins with distinct work roles; controlled stone split, ordinary tools, fine dust and matching detail studies.
images.creator_feedback: last one is cool too - the quarry one a well - different types of magic are good
images.approval_scope: Quarry singer accepted; the variety of magic is explicitly liked.

images.title: Brazen gatebeast
images.intent: A large bronze guardian explores the presence and anatomy of a nonhuman construct.
images.boundary: Tests a larger made being while leaving its motive power, maker and allegiance open.

A monumental NONHUMANOID bronze guardian, approximately 3 meters at shoulder and 6 meters long, with a low broad four-legged silhouette suggesting the mass of a boar crossed with an ancient guardian beast, yet unmistakably a crafted being. An imposing enduring made presence with restrained design, not a mechanical pet and not a humanoid stone colossus.
